checks.title: Feature stability across repeated runs
checks.observed: Only 0 of 5 repeated run(s) completed with an adequate evaluation sample; at least 3 are needed.
checks.threshold: FAIL if a material numeric feature's effect direction agrees in < 0.8 of runs; if two material features whose importances differ significantly (Bonferroni-corrected t-test) swap order in > 20% of runs; or if a top-3 driver of one run makes no significant contribution in another (driver dropout). Mean Spearman of material-feature ranks < 0.6 without those conditions (swaps among statistically tied features) is a WARN.
checks._diagnostic_note: Statistical diagnostic of model behaviour — not a regulatory approval.
checks._methodology: Repeated seeded re-split + retrain with the model's configuration; each run's test-row fingerprint is recorded and the runs count only if their test sets differ. Per run: permutation importance of every input on held-out rows (AUC drop when shuffled) and the direction of each numeric feature's effect on predicted PD. Stability = agreement of importance ranks (Spearman) and directions across runs, judged among material features (selected in at least half of the runs).
_limitations: Acceptance criteria are PROVISIONAL defaults (stability_criteria.json); the policy values (min_mean_rank_correlation, min_pair_order_consistency, material_rank_shift_fraction, material_rank_shift_min, min_direction_consistency, top_k, min_class_count, max_ci_width) await Model Risk approval.
5 run(s) excluded: evaluation sample too small (fewer than 10 of a class, or AUC interval wider than 0.2), so importances are too noisy to compare.
Permutation importances are estimated on each run's held-out rows; smaller samples give noisier importances, which shows up as larger dispersion across runs.

_removal_diagnostics.rule: AUC gain on removal > 2.0 × bootstrap SE of the baseline AUC
_removal_diagnostics.note: Diagnostic only: removing a feature and seeing AUC rise suggests noise or over-fitting; it is not by itself evidence of feature instability.

checks.title: Predictive performance stability across repeated runs
checks.observed: Test set has 8 defaults and 10 non-defaults; at least 10 of each are needed.
checks.threshold: Run-to-run AUC variation not significantly larger than sampling error (Cochran's Q, alpha=0.05); no run significantly below the pooled AUC and no period significantly below the overall AUC (one-sided, Bonferroni-corrected)
checks._diagnostic_note: Statistical diagnostic of model behaviour — not a regulatory approval.
checks._methodology: Repeated seeded re-split + retrain with the model's configuration; each run's test-row fingerprint is recorded and the runs count only if their test sets differ. Per run: held-out ROC-AUC with a stratified-bootstrap standard error. Run-to-run variation is compared with sampling error (Cochran's Q heterogeneity test, I²); each run is tested for significant deterioration against the pooled AUC and each chronological period against the overall test AUC (one-sided, Bonferroni-corrected); the model's test AUC gets a stratified-bootstrap confidence interval.
_limitations: Acceptance criteria are PROVISIONAL defaults (stability_criteria.json); the policy values (min_mean_rank_correlation, min_pair_order_consistency, material_rank_shift_fraction, material_rank_shift_min, min_direction_consistency, top_k, min_class_count, max_ci_width) await Model Risk approval.
5 run(s) excluded: fewer than 10 of a class in the evaluation sample.
